name: Spinach Souffle
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Boil and chop spinach, and while hot stir in butter and beaten egg, salt, and nutmeg
Season with a little sugar and pepper, and set away to get cold
When you are ready for it, whip into the cold spinach the cream and the stiffened whites of the eggs
Pour into a handsome bake-dish, sift a small teaspoonful of powdered sugar on top, and bake in a hot oven ten minutes, covered, five minutes when you have uncovered it
Send immediately to table, as it soon falls
Each portion should be helped out upon a square of fried bread

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil and chop spinach, and while hot stir in butter and beaten egg, salt, and nutmeg
2. Season with a little sugar and pepper, and set away to get cold
3. When you are ready for it, whip into the cold spinach the cream and the stiffened whites of the eggs
4. Pour into a handsome bake-dish, sift a small teaspoonful of powdered sugar on top, and bake in a hot oven ten minutes, covered, five minutes when you have uncovered it
5. Send immediately to table, as it soon falls
6. Each portion should be helped out upon a square of fried bread
